title: So, I watched The Killing by Cubric

commenti.body:
>But I was sleepy and watched this movie while do something else, so I think that i need to rewatch it but with more attention. 

By no means.  Ctenli Cubric wants you to watch his movies that way--he tells us so in his podcasts.
It's no matter what author wants to, honestly.

I remember seeing this for the first time ever in a theater, and although I knew it was coming, that ending still made me audibly gasp out loud. Love this movie and how you can see other crime/heist movies that pull from it
Joking aside, I think Lav Diaz is a director who says that he expects people to fall asleep during his often 5 hour+ films.

I think my main problem with the film was the incredibly stiff acting. It's almost like there's a gun pointed to their heads or something (but considering that it's a Kubrick film, that may not be too far from reality).
